title: feat(headerFooter): Only add markup if a template is defined
body:
Fixes #370

BREAKING CHANGE: The `<div class="ais-header">` and `<div
class="ais-footer">` markup is only added when
a `templates.{header,footer}` is passed.

comments.body: I've just rebased, this is ready too.
